extracted.intended_audience: partner marketers and partners issuing press releases that mention Google News
extracted.subtask_short: partner press release approval for Google News
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for partner-created press releases that mention the Google News brand or products, covering required review/approval, submission logistics, and restrictions (boilerplate, logos, quotes).

rubrics_metrics.name: Review and approval required for mentions of Google News
rubrics_metrics.description: Any press releases mentioning the Google News brand or products requires review and approval.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All partner press materials that mention Google News must be submitted for Google's review and cannot be issued without that approval.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission contact and lead time
rubrics_metrics.description: Please send materials to press@google.com for review at least 72 hours before you plan to issue it, and include any questions you may have.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit draft materials to the provided email address with any questions; allow a minimum of 72 hours for review prior to the planned issuance date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Google quotes are not generally provided
rubrics_metrics.description: Google does not generally provide quotes for press materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requests for quotes may be considered on a case-by-case basis, but partners should not rely on receiving a Google quote for press releases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not include Google boilerplate, contact info, or logo (no joint releases)
rubrics_metrics.description: Please do not include the Google boilerplate, contact information or Google logo on your press release. These details imply a joint-press release, and Google does not support joint-releases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Omitting Google-specific boilerplate, contact details, and logos avoids implying a co-branded/joint press release, which Google does not permit; ensure partner releases are independent in presentation.
